adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, the line `contents << "\n<hr>..."` appends to the caller-provided String object in place. Ruby Strings are mutable and passed by reference, so any caller holding onto `contents` (for reuse, logging, computing a digest elsewhere, etc.) will observe it changed after the call. This side effect is directly verifiable from the diff and is a reasonable correctness hazard unless the method explicitly documents that it mutates its argument.
